name: Grid
description: A layout primitive: its children in equal columns, with the gap from the space scale. With minItemWidth the columns drop as the grid narrows, so a dashboard reflows to one column on a phone. No Tailwind needed. Replaces Livewire's widget-grid.

props.name: columns
props.description: The number of columns, 1 to 12; the most there are when minItemWidth is set. Emitted as data-columns.

props.name: minItemWidth
props.description: The narrowest a column may get, any CSS length (16rem). The grid shows fewer columns rather than narrower ones, down to one. Sets --apui-grid-min-item-width on the root.
props.a11y: Set it for content that must reflow at 320px.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between rows and columns, a step of the space scale (4 is --apui-space-4, 16px). Emitted as data-gap.

props.name: align
props.description: How items sit in their row along the block axis (align-items). Emitted as data-align.

props.name: justify
props.description: How items sit in their column along the inline axis (justify-items), which follows the text direction. Emitted as data-justify.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The grid; every child is an item.

requirements: Layout only: no role, and the reading order is the source order, which the columns keep.
Columns run in the text direction, so they start at the inline end in RTL.
With minItemWidth the grid reflows to one column at narrow widths (1.4.10).
